Help make the bread people enjoy every morning! Start working as a Bakery Operator in Hedel and play an important role in the production process. You will work 38 hours per week in rotating shifts from Monday to Sunday. With shift allowances, you can earn up to € 35,36 per hour during night shifts. 
About the job 
As a Bakery Operator, you make sure the packing process runs smoothly. You set up machines, monitor the production line, and check the quality of the products before they are sent to customers. If there is a small machine problem, you solve it yourself or together with your colleagues. 
You will work in a 3-shift system: - 06:00 - 14:00 - 14:00 - 22:00 - 22:00 - 06:00 
The schedule is made every week, so your shifts may change weekly. Thanks to extra allowances for evening, night, and weekend work, your hourly wage can increase to €35.36 per hour. 
What we offer - Salary between € 16,89 and € 35,36 per hour, including shift allowances; - Travel allowance of € 0,23 per km from 10 km; - 25 vacation days and 8.33% holiday pay; - Pension plan from your first working week; - Weekly or 4-weekly salary payment; - Free coffee, tea, and fruit at work; - Opportunities for personal development and career growth. 
What we ask - You speak Dutch or English; - You have experience as an Operator. 
About the company 
This bakery in Hedel operates day and night. Fresh bread, bakery products, and seasonal specialties such as Christmas and Easter breads are made here every day for major supermarkets across the Netherlands.
